jobs.how: There is no start/stop object. The BAS takes control through Operating Mode and Remote Signal, and Unit Failsafe Mode decides what the unit does if it loses the BAS.

points.use: Write 0 Constant Setpt, 1 Rmt Setpt, 2 Outdoor Reset
Write 0 = BAS so the remote setpoint comes from BACnet
Write 0 Standby or 1 Constant Setpt on BAS loss
Read active BAS protocol, 1 MSTP, 2 IP

jobs.how: Write the unit setpoint to AV 4 and confirm it on Active Setpoint Temp. The setpoint low and high limits bound the allowed setpoint.

points.use: Read the setpoint currently in use

jobs.how: Read outlet, inlet, outdoor and header temperatures. Values are listed in °F; AV 8 switches the BAS interface between English and Metric.

points.use: Write to switch BAS units English / Metric

jobs.how: Unit Status gives the operating state and Power Output the current output. On BMK E, power limit management can cap output.

points.use: Read state: 1 Standby, 3 Automatic, 5 Fault, 7 Starting
Read current power output % (BMK E only)
Write 1 to enable power limit management (BMK E)

jobs.job: Cascade plant on a BST manager
jobs.how: Connect the BAS to the BST manager only. It takes the plant setpoint on AV 200 and reports plant-wide temperatures, output and unit counts.

points.use: Read plant setpoint currently in use
Read plant mode: 0 Constant, 1 Rmt Setpt, 2 Outdoor Reset
Read units available to the cascade

jobs.how: The manager exposes a read-only block per unit: unit 1 is AI 300-320, unit 2 is AI 400-420, up to unit 16 at AI 1800-1820. Points marked legacy BMK only are not used on BMK E.

points.use: Read unit 1 state, 4 Unit Fault, 8 Comm Error

jobs.how: On a BST manager, enable the setback schedule and set the setback setpoint with its start and stop times.

points.use: Write Enable / Disable for the setback schedule

jobs.how: Active Event ID carries the event or fault code and Unit Status shows Fault. On a cascade, Units Faulted counts faulted units and each unit block has its own state and event code.

points.use: Read number of units faulted in the cascade
Read unit 1 state; alarm on Unit Fault or Comm Error

checklist: Log in at technician level on the Edge X controller, since BAS points are not available without it.
Go to Settings > Advanced Setup > Comm & Failsafe and enable BAS; for IP turn on the 'BAS (J6)' toggle, which actually uses the J5 Ethernet jack.
Set DHCP or a fixed IP, the device-instance offset, UDP port and network number, or for MS/TP wire J16 pins 5 (+) and 7 (-), set the baud and use the TERM1 switch at the trunk ends.
On a cascade, connect the BAS to the BST manager only; the clients talk to it over Modbus RS-485.
Discover the unit and read AI 1 (Unit Status), AI 2 (Outlet Temp), AI 0 (Active Event ID) and AI 155 (BAS Enable), and check AV 8 for English or Metric units.
Set AV 24 (Unit Failsafe Mode) to Standby or Constant Setpt so a lost BAS connection is handled the way the site wants.
Write AV 12 (Operating Mode) = 1 and AV 13 (Remote Signal) = 0, then write AV 4 (Setpoint), or AV 200 on a BST manager, and confirm it on AI 16 or AI 114.
On a cascade, check AI 107 (Units Available) and each unit block from AI 301 against the plant.
Map AI 0, AI 1 (5 = Fault), AI 108 (Units Faulted) and each unit's Cascade Client State (AI 301, 401 and so on) as alarms.
